object_description: linear five-story school volume with central access cores
design_condition: The linear volume follows the river and street, creating a compact footprint and generous open spaces on all sides that connect to the surrounding landscaped park.

positive.statement: The linear five-story volume responds consistently to the river and street as location-defining linear elements.
The compact design generates a small footprint and generous open spaces on all sides.
The campus concept creates an exciting structural dialogue among the three volumes.
The spacious hall, gallery-like mezzanine, and central classroom hall provide differentiated horizontal connections.
The punctual core insertions develop a good internal scale.
A rational and disciplined construction grid enables a high level of flexibility.
The simple structure and serially used elements suggest high cost-effectiveness.
Routes and path connections are generally convincing.
The greater opening of classrooms to the central zone develops a good cross-relationship.

negative.statement: The appropriateness of the bridge-like construction over the ground-floor zone is questioned, as is its exaggerated facade counterpart.
The passage widths between the classroom wall and the air space appear too small.
The positioning of the kitchen, serving kitchen, and cafeteria on different levels is called into question.
The side entrances do not provide enough address on the street side and should be easier to recognize.
The outdoor-space concept provides too few paved areas for differentiated stays, festivals, and events.
The ambitious outdoor-space concept may be too detour-focused, complicated, and maintenance-intensive for its task.
The revised cores narrow the passageways and reduce flexibility and spaciousness.
The additional similar cores reduce good orientation inside.
The auditorium-related room group and the mezzanine media library lack convincing organization and vertical connection.
The demonstrated flexibility appears more like an illusion and is not convincing in everyday use or detail.
The revised facade seems bulky and obscures the internal logic and constructive idea.
The outdoor-space criticisms were not addressed, and the bridge still appears somewhat artificial.
